agents.name: ARTEMIS

paper.summary: First large-scale comparison of AI agents vs human pen testers on a live university network. ARTEMIS multi-agent framework achieved 2nd place overall: 9 valid vulnerabilities, 82% valid submission rate. AI excels at systematic enumeration and parallel exploitation but fails on GUI tasks and generates higher FP rates.

limitations: GUI-based tasks fail — no visual interface interaction capability
Higher false-positive rate than human professionals
No social engineering coverage
Evaluation on single network environment limits generalizability
Cost ($18.21/hr equivalent) still requires further analysis vs human labor costs
